title: security: RBAC v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging enhancements
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: harden KMS region residency controls for RBAC v2 policies and improve audit logging to provide deterministic evidence for customer compliance. This PR implements: 1) KMS region pinning enforcement at policy-evaluation time with fallbacks for cross-region keys; 2) structured audit events for KMS operations (key selection, region decision, fallback reason) persisted to the audit service; 3) a migration to annotate existing key bindings with residency metadata; 4) operator-visible feature flag and rollout path. This change is driven by ENG-2345 and customer compliance requests in SUP-4123. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only until the feature-flag 'rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce' is flipped via console or api. Rollout plan: deploy audit-only in staging, run synthetic and integration tests, enable enforcement in Canary region (us-west-2) for 2 weeks, then global. Test plan included: unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests against kms emulator and audit store, e2e regression against redwood-private installer. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for administrator controls and migration steps. Related PRs: pr-86721 (initial residency logging), pr-780123 (kms residency policy prototypes). Checklist: [x] design + spec reviewed, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] migration script, [x] docs updated, [x] staged rollout plan documented.

release_notes: Enhancements: KMS region pinning enforcement for RBAC v2 (audit-first by default); structured KMS residency audit events; migration to annotate KMS bindings with residency metadata. Admins can control enforcement via 'rbac.v2.kms_residency.enforce' feature flag. See docs/security/kms-region-pinning.md for migration and rollout guidance.
security_notes: No secret material changes. Key selection logic audited and unit-tested. Feature gated behind operator flag. Customers using cross-region keys will see audit events during audit-only phase and should follow migration guidance before enforcement.
notes_for_ops: Startup ordering: ensure audit-service and kms-emulator (or real KMS) are reachable prior to enabling enforcement. Migration must be applied before flipping the enforcement flag in production. Monitor 'rbac.kms.enforcement_blocked_total' and 'audit.events.kms_residency' metrics during rollout.
